snippet.title: Cosmic Crumbs: Demo - Trailer
snippet.description:
🍞 Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator Demo is coming October 8th! 🚀

Try out the demo in 3 days and wishlist the full game now! ⭐
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4962420/Cosmic_Crumbs_Bakery_Simulator_Demo

Run your own futuristic bakery solo or with up to 4 players! Bake, brew, serve customers, upgrade your equipment, and even hire a robotic assistant. 🤖☕
